subject: health
unitTitle: Sexual Health, Disease Prevention, and Community Action
title: Guided practice: testing and healthcare supports
essentialQuestion: How can understanding sexual health, disease prevention, and community action help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Testing and healthcare support can provide information, prevention, or treatment; ask the provider what a service includes, whether consent is needed, and how privacy works.
Identify the actual biological process or transmission route, choose prevention or care that interrupts it, and correct myths without blaming or stigmatizing a person.
For testing and healthcare supports, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Complete a fact-checked community-health project with family review choices, private questions, and no disclosure requirement.
studentTask: Create a cause-and-interruption map for a supplied fictional case about testing and healthcare supports: name the relevant process or transmission route, add two accurate prevention or care supports, and correct one misconception using the lesson facts.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in testing and healthcare supports; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the testing and healthcare supports task using the supplied fictional or public case.
